project.purpose: Bind exact subject bytes to declared profile semantics, route admitted capabilities, preserve bounded evidence observations, and derive only justified Artifact standing; treat build, trust, packaging, durability, agent intent and transport as provider/adapter layers.

nodes.label: SubjectCommitment
nodes.responsibility: Bind the exact bytes and optional exact object-contract bytes under evaluation.

nodes.label: ProfileSemantics
nodes.responsibility: Define the bounded claims, evidence expectations, targets and non-claims applicable to one Artifact profile.

nodes.label: CapabilityBinding
nodes.responsibility: Resolve profile plus operation to one admitted capability implementation and its standing.

nodes.label: EvidenceObservation
nodes.responsibility: Represent what one bounded method actually observed over exact subject bytes.

nodes.label: StandingDecision
nodes.responsibility: Derive only the claims justified by profile semantics plus admitted observations.

nodes.label: BuildProvider
nodes.responsibility: Produce candidate native bytes from admitted exact source/material commitments.

nodes.label: VerifierPlugin
nodes.responsibility: Produce bounded evidence observations for one profile/capability over exact subject bytes.

nodes.label: TrustOverlay
nodes.responsibility: Authenticate or authorize evidence/standing using explicit trust policy and cryptographic material.

nodes.label: PackageAssembler
nodes.responsibility: Assemble artifact, evidence and trust material into an external package/release representation.

nodes.label: OperationAdapter
nodes.responsibility: Map generic Artifact operation requests to kernel and provider services.

nodes.label: DurableRuntimeAdapter
nodes.responsibility: Provide replay-safe durable execution without becoming Artifact semantic authority.

nodes.label: AgentIntentAdapter
nodes.responsibility: Project bounded agent/user intent into canonical ArtifactOperation or explicit verification/doctor execution plans.

nodes.label: ProfileV1Compatibility
nodes.responsibility: Preserve production Office/Web profile-v1 behavior while proving equivalence to any future normalized evaluation model.

nodes.label: TransportCapability
nodes.responsibility: Move bytes or issue bounded transport capabilities.

nodes.label: ToolchainEnvironment
nodes.responsibility: Probe and manage execution-tool availability and environment facts.

nodes.label: ConsumerDomainAcceptance
nodes.responsibility: Decide whether technically standing Artifact bytes are appropriate for Game, Research, Media or another caller.

nodes.label: HumanPreferenceAuthority
nodes.responsibility: Supply subjective visual/editorial/business preference judgments when explicitly required.

edges.label: consumer may use Artifact standing as evidence, not authority

divergences.label: DualEvaluationBackbones
divergences.observation: Production Office/Web verification and standards-first family verification use different evaluation models.

divergences.label: CompositionRootConcentration
divergences.observation: DirectPythonOperationProvider has 17 project-module dependencies and a 513-line class.

divergences.label: TrustMultiResponsibility
divergences.observation: artifact_trust/vsa.py combines statement, policy, crypto-tool effect and aggregation responsibilities.

divergences.label: OciOrchestrationConcentration
divergences.observation: execute_oci_package_stage is 362 lines with 30 conditional branches.

divergences.label: TransportBoundaryDrift
divergences.observation: R2 mailbox implementation remains in the Artifact repository despite donor classification DO_NOT_PROMOTE.

divergences.label: ImplicitVerifierPluginProtocol
divergences.observation: Nineteen capability bindings already route to family verifier module/callable entrypoints, but plugin packaging/interface is not formalized.

divergences.label: ClaimAddressabilityGap
divergences.observation: Across 19 bound verify profiles, 102 requiredEvidence keys exist but no profile has complete same-name coverage in standing bindings or verifier source; generic standing cannot safely infer missing claim mappings.

slices.objective: Pressure-test one common EvaluationRequest/EvidenceObservation/StandingDecision model against four real profiles without changing production routing.
Pressure-test an explicit claimResults VerifierPlugin contract on WAVE, PNG and legacy verify-stage compatibility without changing production routing.
Add backward-compatible explicit claimResults to WAVE and PNG native verifier outputs and prove existing routes/callers remain unchanged.
Separate Trust statement, policy, Sigstore effect and aggregation responsibilities at the design/test boundary.
Map DirectPython operation-kind branches into independent handlers while preserving one composition root.
Model OCI package plan/admission/staging/layout/release-decision as package-plugin internals without changing bytes.
Classify mailbox, doctor, environment and transport/publication tooling into retain, quarantine or externalize.

questions: Can one EvaluationRequest represent both profile-v1 Office/Web verification and profile-v2 family verification without semantic loss?
What is the minimum EvidenceObservation schema that works across target render, structural validators, family validators and readback?
Should StandingDecision be profile/policy-owned rather than verifier-owned?
Can Trust remain completely downstream of unsigned evidence observations?
Can profile-v1 Office/Web become a verifier plugin without prematurely promoting profile-v2?
Should R2 mailbox move to external delivery infrastructure or remain quarantined transport tooling?

review.notes: Delivery Python/CLI facade and CLI fallback provider are retired. Agent build intent now projects to ArtifactOperation; Temporal defaults exclusively to DirectPythonOperationProvider. Profile-v1 dual-contract debt remains explicit and separate.
